parrafo_1.es: Gator Plumbing & Bath es el trabajo de Jeremy Clepper, plomero licenciado (CFC1450033) en Newberry, FL. Remodela banos completos, instala y repara calentadores de agua, cambia tanques de pozo y resuelve fugas en casas de Gainesville y alrededores.
parrafo_1.en: Gator Plumbing & Bath is the work of Jeremy Clepper, a licensed plumber (CFC1450033) based in Newberry, FL. He handles full bathroom remodels, installs and repairs water heaters, replaces well tanks and fixes leaks for homes across Gainesville and the surrounding area.

parrafo_2.es: Quienes dejan resenas en Google destacan su honestidad, que nunca intenta venderte de mas y que resuelve emergencias, como una fuga de madrugada, el mismo dia que lo llaman.
parrafo_2.en: Reviewers on Google point to his honesty, that he never tries to upsell, and that he handles emergencies, like a leak in the middle of the night, the same day they call.

texto.es: Cuentanos el proyecto: remodelacion de bano, calentador, tanque de pozo o fuga.

items.quote: Could not be more pleased with the professionalism of the trade and the quality of work that Jeremy with Gator Plumbing and Bath puts out. Hands down the most talented plumber in Gainesville and the surrounding area.
Jeremy offers a fair price and personalized service. He is a very honest dude and won't try to upsell you on things. Everything he recommends is based upon his expertise and experience.
I woke up on a Saturday morning to the sound of water gushing through my walls. I called the three most well-known plumbing companies in Gainesville... Jeremy is your guy for all your plumbing needs!
